note: Recorded shapes for modelrack.providers.openai_compatible's conformance and unit tests (spec §19: a provider version bump triggers re-capture and a changelog note). Fixture bodies here are representative payloads matching the documented OpenAI chat-completions wire format that llama.cpp server and LM Studio both implement, not a byte-for-byte capture from a running server — this repository has neither installed. There is no tests/live counterpart for this adapter yet; Phase 4's acceptance criteria are met against these recorded fixtures, the same way Ollama's were before its own live suite existed.
